newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine bonds slip with U.S. Treasuries.
newsitem.headline: Argentine bonds slip with U.S. Treasuries.

text.p: Argentine bonds were slightly lower late morning Tuesday, tracking U.S. Treasuries down in slim activity.
"There is not much of a market - there is little volume and small flows," said a trader at a local bank.
Argentina's FRB Brady bond due 2005 fell 1/8 to 92-7/8 while the dollar-denomiinated Bocon Previsional 4 due 2002 slipped $0.10 to 115.60.
Another trader said Argentine bonds were set to range-trade considering the slight movements in the U.S. Treasury market.
In the absence of any key U.S. indicators before next week, the market could well tread water until then, said the trader.
